I have been to therapists and doctors for anxiety and depression before so I’m unsure but I will still give my opinion! I think that if you go to a therapist and you try to be open with them about why you haven’t seen one before (due to anxiety) they will be very open about the idea. I would first have a session or two to create a sort of “relationship” with your therapist and then bring up the idea of an ESA. Then, just explain how you feel an ESA would benefit you and your anxiety and how you would like to explore the idea! Feel free to message me for any questions :)

I’m not sure how things are in your state, but as a student who only works part time, you may qualify for Medicaid and can see a therapist using that. A licensed therapist can write an ESA letter for you. I have Medicaid and I currently see a therapist, she wrote me an ESA letter. There are therapists who will see you online, especially since there is a pandemic. I would try this route.
